Four-armed seraptis demons are radical nihilists at heart, despising other creatures out of bitter entitlement and laughing hysterically when others die or suffer. They arise from souls that engaged in dedicated campaigns of misery, driving their victims toward despair and suicide. After their awakening as a seraptis, the hungry mouths carved into their arms devour others' suffering, bringing a lively hue to the demon's cold skin. These demons seek to drag mortals down to their level, luring pawns into deepseated resentment. Feeding their targets an unending stream of half-truths and propaganda, they often drive these mortals to vent their rage into unforgivable deeds against innocents. Although thrilled by the misery their mortal pawns inflict, the demons' true comfort is to harvest the souls of those pawns as more of their kind. **[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 34 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 29 [Seraptis](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2899) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 80 **Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) **Languages** [Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet, [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +30, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +31, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +29, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +27, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +28 **Str** +8 **Dex** +7 **Con** +6 **Int** +3 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +6 **Items** _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2854) [scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=393)_ (2) --- **AC** 37 **Fort** +27 **Ref** +28 **Will** +25 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644) **HP** 340 **Weaknesses** [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 15, [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 15 **Blood Healing** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) 30 feet. Whenever a humanoid within the aura takes bleed damage, the blood flows through the air to the seraptis's mouths and the seraptis heals by the same amount.
**Recovery Vulnerability** When a creature within the seraptis's blood healing aura recovers from [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), the seraptis takes 3d6 mental damage. --- **Speed** 40 feet, fly 40 feet **Melee** _wounding scimitar_ +32 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d6+16 slashing plus 2d6 mental and 1d6 persistent bleed **Melee** claw +31 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 2d4+16 slashing plus 2d6 mental and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Ranged** caustic blood +30 ([Acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)), **Damage** 7d6 acid **Divine Innate Spells** DC 35 - **3rd** [Illusory Disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=159) (at will) - **4th** [Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) (at will) - **5th** [Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) - **8th** [Dominate](/Spells.aspx?ID=87), [Phantasmal Calamity](/Spells.aspx?ID=218), [Wave of Despair](/Spells.aspx?ID=1757) - **Constant (8th)** [Truesight](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727), [Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **Rituals** DC 36 - **1st** [Demonic Pact](/Rituals.aspx?ID=142) **Bloody Dance** The seraptis makes a Strike with up to four arms, each against a different target and using a claw or scimitar as appropriate. These attacks count toward the seraptis's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks. The seraptis can use [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) following this activity, separately attempting to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) each creature hit by a claw. **Gnawing Arms** ([Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) **Requirements** The seraptis has at least one creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90); **Effects** The seraptis's arm mouths gnaw on those creatures, dealing each of them 2d6+8 piercing damage with a DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. Creatures that fail the save also take 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). **Isolating Words** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101)) The seraptis telepathically explains a plausible secret to a creature within 30 feet. That creature must succeed at a DC 37 Will save or be mentally cut off from those around them for 1 minute (or permanently on a critical failure). The affected creature treats no one as an ally and any speech they hear is warped, encouraging conflict, and negating any [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642) ability from creatures that aren't [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521). Regardless of the results of the saving throw, the creature is immune to Isolating Words for 24 hours.
